epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce infrastructure-related deployment blocking issues from current baseline to 0
requirements: R1: Update the MinIO image tag in the deployment configuration from the unresolvable RELEASE.2023-09-20T22-40-07Z to a valid release

slices.title: Fix unresolvable MinIO image tag in Docker compose
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this epic, I want to update the MinIO docker image tag to a valid release, so that the product runtime environment boots successfully and technical debt is eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker compose configuration referencing an unresolvable MinIO image tag,
When the configuration is updated to a valid Docker Hub MinIO image tag,
Then the 'docker compose up' command successfully pulls the image and the runtime environment boots without reference errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Docker boot failure rate from 100% to 0% for the MinIO service
